caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile featuring a repeating pattern of red floral motifs and birds on a beige background. The textile shows a complex arrangement with large stylized flowers, leafy branches, and star-like shapes across the main area. Two birds face each other at the lower center portion, set amid symmetrical plant forms. On the right side, a vertical decorative border contains two additional birds surrounded by floral and leaf patterns, along with a rectangular block of text that reads: "MADE BY J. HARTMAN HILTON TOWNSHIP FOR MARTHA THEW 1844." The right edge of the textile is adorned with thick red fringes, while the bottom edge has finer, lighter-colored (grayish or light blue) fringes. The overall color palette consists primarily of red threads contrasted against a neutral beige or off-white background.
title: Coverlet
